scenes.narration: But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand. Now, with unified data context across Runs on what the operator already has open — no additional configuration, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary. It can go further in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on. With Store Associate Copilot Agent, retail cpg get guided assistance embedded directly into their workflows.
